name: ai-workflow-orchestration-platform
description: Dashboard + Kubernetes-scaled microservices for running AI workflows

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev:api" "npm --prefix backend run dev:worker" "npm --prefix web start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix web run build
